Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are walking out to the middle now. The two openers for India Women are Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana. Sri Lanka Women going with spin straightaway as Oshadi Ranasinghe is ready to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go ...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, Sri Lanka Women have only managed to get to a total of 65 runs and it will take an extra ordinary effort from their bowlers to defend this one. India Women will be really happy with their bowlers and with their batting line up, this should be an easy chase for them. Who will get their hands on the trophy? Will it be India Women or Sri Lanka Women? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Sneh Rana is down for a chat. She says she is happy to restrict Sri Lanka Women to 65 runs, and they executed their plans perfectly. On Renuka Singh, she says that Renuka was brilliant with the ball, she gave a good start to them and she bowled according to plan. Mentions that the pitch is turning and it is very good for the spinners.

This has been an absolute annihilation by the India Women bowlers. They were on point right from the start and were also helped by some poor running between the wickets from the Lankan batters. Renuka Singh showed her magic once again and was very well supported with the spinners. She picked up three wickets for just 5 runs in her three overs. They gave nothing away and always kept the batters under pressure. Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Sneh Rana picked up two wickets each as well. Their batters now have a comfortable chase on their hands to win the title.

Sri Lanka Women will be hugely disappointed with their batting effort and it was visible on the faces of their players. They never looked like going and were under pressure right from the start. Poor shot selection and miscommunication in the middle cost them a lot too. Only two of their batters scored in double digits and Inoka Ranaweera finished well in the last over. It will be difficult for them to erase this from their memory but they still have to come out to defend. However, they saved some pride by batting the 20 overs.

We have seen a bowling masterclass from the India Women and they have restricted Sri Lanka Women to just 65 runs. The Women in Blue will be confident to chase this down and lift the trophy for the 7th time in their history.

FOUR! A boundary to wrap the innings up! Tossed up, around middle, full in length. Inoka Ranaweera lifts this one over the bowler's head and towards the long on fence for a boundary. Sri Lanka Women end at 65 for 9!
Wide! Down the leg side, Inoka Ranaweera misses her flick. Wided.
FOUR! Up and over! Tossed up, around middle. Inoka Ranaweera steps down the wicket and tonks it straight down the ground for a boundary. A rare boundary but much needed.
Outside off, fuller ball. Inoka Ranaweera drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Pitched up again, around middle and leg. Achini Kulasuriya gets down on her knee and sweeps this one but the ball goes off the top edge towards the vacant slip region. A single!
Outside off, short in length, it stays low as well. Achini Kulasuriya leaves it alone.
Full, around middle and off. Inoka Ranaweera pushes it to long on for a single.
Full and outside off. Inoka Ranaweera drives it towards mid off. Shafali Verma fumbles there and allows the batters to cross ends.

An excellent stop from Harmanpreet Kaur! Outside off, a shorter ball. Achini Kulasuriya slashes it through cover. Harmanpreet Kaur dives to her right and makes a half-stop with her right hand. A single taken. Saved three there.
Shortish ball, outside off, turning away. Achini Kulasuriya misses it while trying to push this one through cover.
Outside off, spinning away. Achini Kulasuriya looks to slog this one away but she misses.
Uppish again! Full, around middle. Inoka Ranaweera lifts it towards the vacant mid on region for a single.
In the air...and safe again! Slower through the air, full, around middle. Achini Kulasuriya looks to flick this one but she gets a leading edge towards mid on. A single now.
Shortish ball, outside the off pole. Inoka Ranaweera lets that go through to the keeper.
Very full this time, outside the off pole. Achini Kulasuriya pushes it wide of long on for a run.
A full toss, around middle. Inoka Ranaweera strokes it towards long on for a single.
This is on a yorker length, on middle, Inoka Ranaweera digs it towards short mid-wicket.
Shafali Verma comes around the wicket and serves this full and n middle, Achini Kulasuriya tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Another delivery way outside off. Wided again.
WIDE! This is ful and outside off, way outside off, Achini Kulasuriya leaves it again. Wided.
Shafali Verma starts with a good-length delivery and outside off, Achini Kulasuriya leaves it alone.
Shafali Verma comes into the attack.
Outside off, pitched it up. Dayalan Hemalatha leaves it alone.
Fuller ball, around middle. Achini Kulasuriya looks to flick this but the ball goes off the leading edge over cover for a single.
Another pitched-up delivery, outside off. Achini Kulasuriya knocks it towards cover.
Outside off, a fuller ball, Achini Kulasuriya pushes it towards cover.
Spinning away, outside off, fuller ball. Achini Kulasuriya leaves it alone.
Full, around middle. Inoka Ranaweera flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Achini Kulasuriya is the last batter in for Sri Lanka Women.

OUT! TIMBER! Sneh Rana grabs her second wicket and Sri Lanka Women have lost their ninth now. An absolute peach once again from Sneh Rana. She tosses it up, it lands around middle and spins away. Sugandika Kumari steps down the pitch and looks to flick this one away. But she misses and the ball goes onto to knock the stumps.
On middle, full ball, Sugandika Kumari blocks it out.
Uppish and safe again! Slightly shorter, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera cuts it just over the fielder at point. A single.
Width on offer again, outside off. Sugandika Kumari once again cuts it uppishly just over the fielder at cover-pont. A single!
Drops it short now, outside off. Sugandika Kumari knocks it off the back foot towards cover.
Pitched up, around middle. Inoka Ranaweera drills it towards long on and takes a single.
Sneh Rana (3-0-11-1) is back on.
Full and on middle. Sugandika Kumari blocks it out.
Slower through the air, full in length, outside off, spinning away. Sugandika Kumari leaves it alone.
Fullish ball, around middle and leg. Inoka Ranaweera strokes it down to long on for a single.
Width on offer now, short one. Sugandika Kumari cuts it uppishly and away from the fielder at point only a single.
Oh, what a ball! Tossed up, this one lands around off and spins away a tad. Sugandika Kumari looks to sweep this but she misses.
Short ball, spinning away, outside off. Sugandika Kumari knocks it towards cover off the back foot.
Dayalan Hemalatha comes to bowl.
A dot to end the over as this short delivery is defended towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Sugandika Kumari sweeps it towards deep square leg for a run.
Short and on middle, Inoka Ranaweera goes back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, on middle, Inoka Ranaweera knocks it to the leg side.
Floated, full and on middle, Inoka Ranaweera tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, fuller ball. Sugandika Kumari drives it through cover for a single.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Sugandika Kumari sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
On middle, full ball, Sugandika Kumari shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
Very full now, around the off pole. Inoka Ranaweera strokes it down to long on for a single.
Slower through the air, full in length again, around middle. Inoka Ranaweera ends up chipping it towards the left of the bowler.
Spinning away, outside off, fuller ball. Inoka Ranaweera leaves it alone.
Full, loopy ball as well, around middle and leg. Sugandika Kumari flicks it towards square leg for a single.

Spinning in, around middle and leg, a fuller ball, Inoka Ranaweera tucks it towards square leg. She wanted a single there, but is sent back in time. There was a throw at the keeper's end but Inoka Ranaweera dives in to make her ground.
Inoka Ranaweera comes to the crease.

OUT! TIMBER! Absolute gift of a wicket! There was no need of this kind of shot but she has to go back to the hut now. Rajeshwari Gayakwad flights this up and around off, turning in a bit, Oshadi Ranasinghe skips down the track and goes for the big shot but plays all over it and the ball goes through to shatter the stumps. Sri Lanka Women eight down now.
Shortish and on middle, Oshadi Ranasinghe knocks it to the leg side.
WIDE! Rajeshwari Gayakwad floats it up, hits the rough in the middle and turns sharply to leg side and keeps really low, Oshadi Ranasinghe looks to play at it but misse. Wided.
Flighted, full and on middle and off, Oshadi Ranasinghe reverse sweeps it with the bottom half past the keeper and towards third man for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, full and around leg, Oshadi Ranasinghe goes for the sweep but misses.
Shorter in length and outside off, Oshadi Ranasinghe opens the face of her bat and steers it towards third man for a brace.
A loopy ball, full and outside off. Sugandika Kumari looks to sweep this one but she misses.
Outside off, tossed-up delivery. Sugandika Kumari leaves it alone.
Flighted full and on off, Sugandika Kumari drives it towards short cover.
A bit short and on off, Oshadi Ranasinghe goes back and pushes it towards backward point for a single.
Floated, full and on off, Oshadi Ranasinghe looks for the reverse sweep but cannot connect.
Tossed up, full and on off, keeps low, Oshadi Ranasinghe looks to cut it away but misses.

Drinks! India Women are right on top at the halfway stage as they have already picked up seven wickets and Sri Lanka Women has not even crossed the 30-run mark. They will try to get these three wickets quickly whereas Sri Lanka Women need a big partnership and to save some pride they need to play the 20 overs.
Flatter delivery now, short in length, around the off pole. Sugandika Kumari pushes it off the back foot towards cover. At the halfway stage, Sri Lanka Women are reeling at 26 for 7.
Tosses this one up, and serves it outside off. Sugandika Kumari leaves it alone.
Outside off again, short one. Sugandika Kumari looks to cut this one now, but she misses.
Beautifully bowled! Spinning away, outside off, short in length. Sugandika Kumari gets beaten on the outside edge while trying to block this one.
Tossed up now, around the leg pole, full in length. Oshadi Ranasinghe sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Wide of off, short in length. Oshadi Ranasinghe goes deep in her crease and looks to pull this but miscues it back to the bowler.
A touch quick now, outside off, a fullish delivery. Sugandika Kumari looks to drive this one but the ball goes off the outside edge towards point. End of a successful first over from Sneh Rana.
Pitches it up again, around the off pole. Sugandika Kumari drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Fuller ball, outside off. Sugandika Kumari leans in and blocks it out.
Sugandika Kumari is the new batter in for Sri Lanka Women.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! The softest dismissal till now. Sri Lanka Women are falling like 9 pins at the moment. A fuller one, slower through the air, turning in a tad, around middle and off. Malsha Shehani shimmies down the pitch and looks to go downtown. But she ends up chipping it back to the bowler. Sneh Rana takes one of the easiest catches. Sri Lanka Women are now 7 down.

Good running! Spinning away, around the off pole, short in length, this one stays low as well. Oshadi Ranasinghe just taps it towards mid-wicket with soft hands and scampers across to the other end. Malsha Shehani dives in to make her ground.
FOUR! Good shot! Much-needed for Sri Lanka Women! Short and width on offer again. Oshadi Ranasinghe hangs back and slashes it through point for a boundary.
Wide! Sneh Rana begins from 'round the wicket, outside off, spinning away. Oshadi Ranasinghe leaves it alone. Wide called.
Sneh Rana comes into the attack now.
Fourth dot on the trot! Outside off, fuller in length. Malsha Shehani blocks it out off the front foot.
Full again, tossed up as well, around off. Malsha Shehani skips down the pitch and defends it out.
Fullish now, turning in, around off. Malsha Shehani prods forward and blocks it out.
Sharp turn again! Outside off, spinning in, a short one. Malsha Shehani walks across and looks to cut this one away she manages to get an inside edge onto the deck.
Full and outside off. Oshadi Ranasinghe pushes it towards cover.
Well bowled! A loopy one, outside off, spinning away. Oshadi Ranasinghe gets beaten on the outside edge while trying to drive this one away.
Deepti Sharma (2-0-5-0) comes back into the attack.
Malsha Shehani comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Nothing seems to go right for Sri Lanka Women. They are all over the place at the moment. Rajeshwari Gayakwad strikes now and sends back Nilakshi de Silva. A shortish ball again, outside off, hint of away turn there. Nilakshi de Silva rocks back and looks to cut it away. But the ball goes off the inside edge and onto the stumps.
Swing and a miss! Tad quicker now, outside off, back of a length, spinning away. Nilakshi de Silva looks to cut this one away but she misses.
Outside off, straight now, short as well. Nilakshi de Silva gets behind the line of the ball and pushes it towards the bowler.
Turning in again, shortish ball, around middle. Oshadi Ranasinghe rocks back and nudges it towards square leg for a run.
Well bowled! A loopy one, full, spinning into the left-hander, around the leg pole. Oshadi Ranasinghe looks to block but she misses and gets hit on her pads. Nice turn on that occasion.
Tossed up, slower through the air, spinning away, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva knocks it off the back foot towards deep cover for a single.

A beauty! Around the fourth stump line, a length ball, angling away. Oshadi Ranasinghe gets beaten on the outside edge while trying to drive this one. A maiden-wicket over from Renuka Singh. Sri Lanka Women are 16 for 5 at the end of the Powerplay!
The line is outside off now, fuller ball. Oshadi Ranasinghe pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
Angling in now, around middle, full again. Oshadi Ranasinghe tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Pitches it up, around middle. Oshadi Ranasinghe leans in and drives it towards cover.
Oshadi Ranasinghe walks out to bat now.

OUT! Another one goes back in the hut. Sri Lanka Women are 5 down inside the Powerplay! Renuka Singh grabs her third wicket with another peach. A length ball, nipping back in, around middle and leg. Kavisha Dilhari looks to flick this one but she misses. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps. Sri Lanka Women are in deep, deep trouble.
Outside off, a fuller ball. Kavisha Dilhari leans in to drive but she misses.
Quicker, full and on middle, skidding through, Kavisha Dilhari tucks it with the inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Kavisha Dilhari blocks it out.
Flatter, full and on middle, keeps low too, Kavisha Dilhari does well to get her bat down in time to keep it out.
Another short delivery, on middle, Nilakshi de Silva goes back and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short again and on off, Nilakshi de Silva stays there and guides it towards point.

EDGED AND FOUR! Rajeshwari Gayakwad starts with a quicker delivery, short and outside off, Nilakshi de Silva looks to cut it but hits it with the toe end and just past the slip fielder towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Full and outside off. Kavisha Dilhari pushes it towards cover. A top-over from Renuka Singh comes to an end.
Wide! Down the leg side, a length ball. Kavisha Dilhari misses her flick. Wided.
Kavisha Dilhari walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Sri Lanka Women are falling like a pack of cards here. Renuka Singh grabs her second wicket of the over and it's a team hat-trick as well. A length ball, slower this time, outside off. Hasini Perera leans in to drive this one but she ends up chipping it towards the fielder at cover. Smriti Mandhana takes a good catch. Hasini Perera departs without troubling the scorers.
Commentary.Howout: c Smriti Mandhana b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! RUN OUT! Another huge mix-up and Sri Lanka Women lose their third wicket! The Indians are delighted. Renuka Singh bowls this slower, full and on middle, Nilakshi de Silva tucks it towards mid-wicket and sets off for the run and her partner responds. However, there is some hesitation in the middle and Anushka Sanjeewani pauses for a second and then continues, Pooja Vastrakar picks up and throws it towards the keeper and Richa Ghosh takes the bails off in a flash. There is a huge appeal for the run out and the umpire sends it upstairs. The replay shows that Anushka Sanjeewani is short of her crease and this is a disastrous start for Sri Lanka Women.
Nilakshi de Silva walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Renuka Singh strikes now and Sri Lanka Women lose their second wicket within the Powerplay. India Women are on top of proceedings early in the innings. Renuka Singh bowls this wide of off, a length delivery, angling away. Harshitha Madavi looks to cut this one away but she manages to get a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Richa Ghosh completes the catch and the umpire raises her finger after a lout shout from the Indians. Harshitha Madavi is on her way back!
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, around the off pole. Harshitha Madavi miscues her drive towards the fielder at cover.
An overpitched delivery, around middle. Harshitha Madavi drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Tad short now, outside off, Harshitha Madavi pushes it off the back foot towards deep cover for a single. She gets off the mark with that!
A peach from Deepti Sharma! A fuller ball, outside off, spinning away sharply. Harshitha Madavi leans in and misses her drive.
Harshitha Madavi comes to the crease!

OUT! RUN OUT! A huge mix-up in the middle and Sri Lanka Women have thrown their first wicket. Deepti Sharma bowls this short and on off, turning away, Chamari Athapaththu pushes it towards short third man and sets off for the run and her partner responds too, but they both abort the run mid way through, and Chamari Athapaththu is in no man's land, Renuka Singh picks up and throws it towards the keeper and Richa Ghosh does the rest. The replay shows that the batter is short of her crease and India Women have the early breakthrough.
Run out chance! There is a throw at the keeper's end. The reply shows that Chamari Athapaththu is short of her ground. Out it is!
Shortish and on off, Anushka Sanjeewani pushes it towards short third man for a single.
Floated, full and on off, Anushka Sanjeewani goes for the reverse sweep but misses and there is an appeal for caught behind but turned down.
Tossed up and on off, Anushka Sanjeewani uses her feet but drills it straight to mid off.

FOUR! That is the first boundary of the innings! Renuka Singh bowls this back of a length and around off, Chamari Athapaththu stays there and punches it away through cover-point for a bouhdary. Delightful shot!
Make that five dot balls! Renuka Singh bowls this on a good length and on off, Chamari Athapaththu guides it towards backward point.
Four dots on the trot! This is on a length and on off, Chamari Athapaththu offers no shot at it.
Renuka Singh serves this full and outside off, Chamari Athapaththu tries to reach for it and push it away but misses and Richa Ghosh collects it well behind the stumps.
This is on a good length and on middle, angling away a bit, Chamari Athapaththu looks to play at it but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW but turned down.
Renuka Singh starts with a pitched up delivery, on middle, angling away, Chamari Athapaththu pushes it towards short cover and sets off for the run but she is sent back and rightly so.
It will be Renuka Singh bowling from the other end.
Gives it some air, short and outside off, Chamari Athapaththu cuts it towards sweper cover for a run. 3 runs from the first over then!
Floated, full and on off, Chamari Athapaththu drives it towards short cover.
Flatter, full and on off, Anushka Sanjeewani waits for it and opens the face of her bat to guide it towards short third man for a single and gets off the mark.

Tossed up, full and on off, Chamari Athapaththu drills it wide of deep point for a single. However, there is an appeal for a run out as the fielder scores a direct hit at the batter's end. The replay shows that the batter is safe. Sri Lanka Women and Chamari Athapaththu are underway!
A bit short and and outside off, Chamari Athapaththu looks to cut it away but misses.
Deepti Sharma starts with a loopy delivery, full and around off, Chamari Athapaththu leans on and pushes it towards point.

We are ready for action to get underway! All the players have made their way out in the middle. Chamari Athapaththu and Anushka Sanjeewani walk out to bat for Sri Lanka Women. Deepti Sharma will begin with the ball. A slip in place. Let's play!

PITCH REPORT - Athar Ali Khan is pitchside. He says that it's a very dry pitch, and spinners will have a good time. But overall a good batting surface.  However, it will be a little struggle at the start for the ball to come on.

Harmanpreet Kaur the captain of India Women says they have a great side and everyone is doing their job, so they are not thinking about the toss. Adds that she is happy everyone is doing well and they are going with their strongest XI and she is sure she will dominate again. Mentions that they wi aim to restrict Sri Lanka Women under 135. Informs they have one change, Dayalan Hemalatha comes in for Radha Yadav.

Chamari Athapaththu the skipper of Sri Lanka Women says that they will bat first. Adds that she is very confident about their batting unit and backs their bowlers to defend it. Mentions that 130-135 is a good score here and further says she is really excited to play in the final.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Richa Ghosh (WK), Pooja Vastrakar, Deepti Sharma, Sneh Rana, Dayalan Hemalatha (In for Radha Yadav), Renuka Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad.

Sri Lanka Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Chamari Athapaththu (C), Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Harshitha Madavi, Nilakshi de Silva, Hasini Perera, Oshadi Ranasinghe, Kavisha Dilhari, Malsha Shehani, Sugandika Kumari, Inoka Ranaweera, Achini Kulasuriya.
TOSS - Sri Lanka Women have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!

Sri Lanka Women, on the other hand, had fought really hard to make their way into the final. They also showed real character against Pakistan Women in the semi-finals, winning by just one run. Chamari Athapaththu will be proud of her team, and they will be oozing with confidence. They have qualified for the final after 14 years, and they can repeat what their Men's team did in the Men's Asia Cup 2022, which should serve as extra motivation. Will it be Indian Women or Sri Lankan Women to get their hands on the trophy? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.

India Women have been pretty dominant in this tournament except for their defeat against arch-rivals Pakistan. Harmanpreet Kaur has led her side from the front and they look like a settled unit. With batters like Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana in their side, along with a decent bowling attack that consists of players like Deepti Sharma and Renuka Singh, they are coming into this final as favourites. India Women will want to overcome their disappointing final loss in the last edition against Bangladesh Women and win the title.

Hello and a warm welcome, folks! We are down to the final two in the Women's Asia Cup 2022. It will be India Women locking horns against Sri Lanka Women and they will be looking to win their 7th title while the latter will give their all to win this for the very first time.
... THE FINALE ...
